title: The wearable future is stuck in weird, experimental, existential limbo
summary: Even now, most people think of wearable devices as fancy step trackers. “Historically, wearables have been very focused on hardcore health enthusiasts,” Rishi Chandra, Google’s vice president of health and home, tells me at a roundtable of tech reporters in New York…
